notes.random: Each is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. These 2 were picked from the os_nq_v1 validation passers using their 2023–2024 results (positive Sharpe in both years, the noise-band overlap check) as well as 2018–2022 and ES, so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice. The real check is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: First open-sweep look at the NQ holdout, but not an untouched one. No open-sweep strategy had been scored on 2025 onward before (apart from the final-test of these same frozen picks), and only these were run, so there's no selection among holdout results. But they were picked after seeing 2023–2024, and other strategy families had already been scored on NQ 2025+ (see their data-access ledgers).

legs.settings_text: 1m bars, overnight (18:00–09:30) range, high or low, whichever triggers first: within 15 min of 09:30 a break by more than 0.05 dATR, then 3 straight close(s) beyond it → trade with the break; stop 0.1 dATR, no target, out by 16:00 ET, flat every night

1m bars, London (02:00–05:00) range, high only: within 30 min of 09:30 a break by more than 0 dATR, then 1 straight close(s) beyond it → trade with the break; stop 0.1 dATR, 3R target, out by 16:00 ET, flat every night
